summary: Dock gate hold blocking kitting pallet; request provisional badge swipe for exchange courier
description:
Issue summary: A 48" kitting pallet (3 crates: 2x GPU risers, 1x docking kit) from vendor TechTransit arrived at SEA dock 2 but was held at the external gate when the courier's carrier badge failed the swipe. Facilities gate log shows access denied due to mismatched container ID and no active provisional swipe.

Impact: Pallet is blocking dock bay traffic. Kitting team needs crates inside for same-day build; delay risks postponing new-hire workstation deployments and could cascade into Friday shipment windows. No customer-facing SLA, internal operational impact (onboarding and hardware inventory).

Environment: SEA office, dock 2 staging area, vendor TechTransit (carrier: PineLogistics). Gate controller: HID Edge v2; badge provisioning via Redwood SSO badge system.

Steps to reproduce: 1) Carrier arrives for scheduled pickup/delivery at SEA dock 2. 2) Courier attempts badge swipe at external gate; gate denies. 3) Courier attempts manual check-in with guard; guard indicates badge not authorized for external bay access for that vendor. 4) Courier places pallet on external pad awaiting escort; facilities escalates to internal-support.

Logs: Gate controller event 2026-03-10T08:52:14Z - swipe denied (UID mismatch). Vendor tracking shows attempted delivery 2026-03-10T08:44Z. Building visitor log shows no temporary escort recorded.

Requested action: Provision provisional swipe (external dock access) valid for 3 hours for PineLogistics driver ID 78431, or arrange escorted transfer to move pallet into staging and sign chain-of-custody. Include confirmation back to kitting and asset ops when in staging.
steps_to_reproduce: Carrier arrives at SEA dock 2 for scheduled delivery
Driver attempts to swipe at external gate; HID Edge v2 responds with 'Access Denied'
Driver requests guard escort; security requires incident reference and confirmation of courier identity
Pallet left on external pad; kitting team cannot proceed until pallet moved into staging
comments: 2026-03-10 09:05 - Facilities (J. Lopez): Gate log shows UID 0x4F2A missing from allowed-external list. Courier provided driver ID 78431. Holding on provisional swipe approval from Security.
2026-03-10 09:22 - Security (A. Patel): We need courier photo ID and carrier manifest scanned into visitor system before a temporary swipe can be issued. Can facilities escort now?
2026-03-10 09:35 - Reporter (M. Chen): Uploaded manifest and driver photo to the ticket (see attachments). Kitting team standing by in staging bay A3.

2026-03-10 09:48 - Security (A. Patel): Provisioned a time-limited guest swipe for external bay (3 hours) scoped to driver UID 78431; gates updated. Please confirm pallet moved in and chain-of-custody signed.
2026-03-10 09:55 - PineLogistics (Courier): Driver confirms provisional swipe worked; pallet moved into staging. Received signature from on-site guard and kitting lead.

2026-03-11 11:20 - Asset Ops (E. O'Neill): Verified crates and serials against manifest. One GPU riser crate (serial GR-8821) shows minor abrasion on corner; logged to inventory note. No missing items.
2026-03-13 15:00 - Assignee (D. Ramirez): Leaving follow-up to confirm badge ACL update for recurring vendor deliveries via Confluence runbook. Marking ticket In Progress until runbook updated.
investigation_notes: Checked HID Edge v2 logs: UID mismatch on external access list; internal access list allowed for dock escorts only.
Hypothesis: Vendor driver not pre-registered in vendor ACL table; vendor deliveries normally pre-authorized via scheduled manifest email which failed for this shipment.
Verified manifest was received but not processed by visitor system due to malformed CSV header (missing 'driver_uid' column) — see gate_controller_log_2026-03-10.csv.
Temporary mitigation: Security issued time-limited guest swipe to specific driver UID; resolved immediate hold and allowed kitting to proceed.
Referenced Slack thread: #facilities (link: slack://channel?team=redwood&name=facilities) and Confluence runbook: Facilities/External-Carrier-Access
resolution: Provisional swipe issued and pallet escorted into staging on 2026-03-10. Asset Ops confirmed contents and logged a minor cosmetic damage on GR-8821; no functional impact. Follow-up actions: (1) Update Confluence runbook to require 'driver_uid' in carrier manifests and add validation step in inbound processing (assigned to D. Ramirez), (2) Add PineLogistics driver whitelist process for recurring vendors (facilities to coordinate), (3) Create a short training note for guards on temporary swipe issuance windows. Target completion: 2026-03-20.
